description: Fetch the full record (all per-language values, status and tags) for a specific set of label keys on a branch. Use this when you already know the exact keys you need, for example from list_labels or search_labels, and want their complete translations. Returns the found labels plus a not_found list of any requested keys that do not exist on the branch. Reads the token's base branch unless `branch` names another allowed branch.

branch.description: Branch to operate on. Defaults to the token's base (bound) branch. May name any branch in the token's allowed set: its base branch, plus branches this token created (only when the token's scope is create-own; see list_branches). Naming any other branch fails with branch_not_allowed.

keys.description: The exact label keys to fetch (at least one).

name: get_labels
title: Get Labels
